lines: With a sudden kiss or a burning gaze,
don't throw my program for love out of order, okay?
Meetings and partings — I've learned to play them well,
when the time comes, it's over. Don't hurry!
Ever since the day love left me wounded,
I've kept living with my days and nights reversed,
and dancing till dawn in the trendy discos,
that's the magic I picked up. I'm sorry!
Never love me seriously,
love is nothing but a game,
as long as I enjoy it, that's enough for me.
Dressing up this closed-off heart — the flashy dress, the shoes,
they're my lonely friends.
The men who ask me out — how ironic it is,
they always resemble him.
Somehow they overlap with my memories,
even if I drop my glass and suddenly well up with tears,
don't ask me why.
On the highway in the dead of night, as I drift off to sleep,
only the halogen lights glow with an eerie light.
"She's a woman cold as ice,"
even if that's what they whisper — Don't worry!
I'm just playing games I know that's plastic love
Dance to the plastic beat Another morning comes
